affected_system: air-quality surveillance, exposure reduction, and respiratory-health response
alternatives: screen feasible locations against the largest access gaps for air-quality monitor and health-protection locations

assumptions: Monitor data retain calibration, siting, uptime, and spatial-representativeness metadata.

constraints.description: The air-quality exposure and respiratory health site must respect declared land control, accessibility, permitting, safety, and operating feasibility.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: environmental health director and air-quality program lead
decision_question: Where should calibrated monitoring and qualified protection resources fill population and uncertainty gaps?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The air-quality exposure and respiratory health site must respect declared land control, accessibility, permitting, safety, and operating feasibility.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for air-quality monitor and health-protection locations passes documented checks for parcel control, legal authority, environmental review, access, capacity, and operator responsibility.
independence_key.primary_outcome: high-risk population without representative monitoring or protection access

intended_claim: A versioned site design for comparing declared alternatives affecting air-quality monitor and health-protection locations, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: high-risk population without representative monitoring or protection access
distributional gap in high-risk population without representative monitoring or protection access
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not call a low-cost sensor regulatory-grade or a candidate facility clinically qualified.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for air-quality monitor and health-protection locations passes documented checks for parcel control, legal authority, environmental review, access, capacity, and operator responsibility.
